entities.summary: President Khatami, a notable figure in the history of Iran, associated with Post-War Islamic Republic and Nuclear Crisis (1989–2005). Preceded by Reconstruction and Reform Era. Their legacy influenced Green Movement and JCPOA nuclear agreement signed between Iran and P5+1.
